title: Nine Degrees of Describing
subtitle: 气候与气候带 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候与气候带（自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：气候与气候带（自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：climate　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 climate 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to describe ① climate she could not change, and she said the describing was the whole of the lesson. The ② climate, meaning the weather and not the place, was nine degrees warmer and was described by whoever came last; climate, she said, is the only thing in a country that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ climate in that country had the same rain, and the ④ climate at the end, meaning the one the farmers kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described properly. Climate, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ climate was the whole of the meeting, meaning the mood it carried and not the weather. The ⑥ climate, meaning the mood and not any of that, is the only thing in a meeting that everybody feels and nobody questions; climate, he said, is either something you describe or the only word that means both weather and a mood. She said the mood is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ climate had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the rain. The ⑧ climate of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine degrees and eleven years of describing; climate, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ climate I remember is the one at the end, which was described in 1974 and is still described as the driest in the county. A ⑩ climate, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being described; every climate, she said, is a mood that has agreed to look like weather. She said the mood was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 气候（指那种天气本身，与那个地方相对）
C. 固定搭配：describe a climate 描述一种气候
D. n. 气候（指那个国家里每一种）
E. n. 气候（指末尾那一种）
F. n. 氛围（抽象：它承载的那种气氛）
G. n. 那种气氛（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The climate, meaning the weather and not the place
climate was the whole of the meeting
the climate had become a number in a report
The climate of the whole thing
A climate, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: describe a climate 意为“描述一种气候”，1954 年母亲被派去描述她改变不了的那种气候。
climate 意为“气候”，指那种天气本身而不是那个地方，暖了九度，由最后来的人描述。
climate 指那个国家里每一种气候，每一种都是同样的雨。
climate 指末尾那一种（农人熟悉的那一种），是唯一有人认真描述过的。
climate 意为“氛围”，抽象指它承载的那种气氛，父亲说 climate 就是那场会议的全部。
climate 为抽象用法，指那种气氛本身，是一场会议里人人都感受到、却没人质疑的东西。
climate 意为“气候”，到 1969 年这种 climate 成了报告里的一个数字。
climate 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九度和十一年的描述。
climate 意为“气候”，我记得的是末尾那一种，1974 年描述过，至今仍被说成全县最干旱的。
climate 为抽象总称，祖母说一种气候是唯一会因为被认真描述而变好的东西。
